items.title: 67255_Helen Humes oral history interview
items.q: He comes to the Club all the time and he brings all his friends. He's been just like my brother.

ctx.x: Well, that's nice. That's better then them disappearing. Well listen, you may not have anything else to say about it but, as I said before, we talked about European fans. I mean you got some very faithful fans in America too.
Oh, haven't I though? In New Orleans, you met Jim, Jim Blackman?
No, but Paul is a friend of your's isn't he? Paul Lentz?
